# Divider { #anylumino.Divider }

```python
Divider(orientation='horizontal', spectrum_size='m', **kwargs)
```

Spectrum divider display control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type     | Description                                                             | Default        |
|---------------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| orientation   | optional | ``'horizontal'`` or ``'vertical'``.                                     | `'horizontal'` |
| spectrum_size | optional | Spectrum component size such as ``'s'``, ``'m'``, ``'l'``, or ``'xl'``. | `'m'`          |
